mechanism: Etanercept (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk and mefloquine has neuropsychiatric toxicity; combined immunosuppression may impair antimalarial efficacy and increase adverse CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if mefloquine is necessary for malaria prophylaxis, consider alternative antimalarials (atovaquone-proguanil or doxycycline) and monitor closely for CNS symptoms and infection.
